## Accepted partial result, first attempt 1/5

Problem 30002633 / OWR-13106-006, rank 1243. The universal estimate |A-hat(M)| <= 2^m kappa(M) for closed spin 4m-manifolds remains unresolved by this work.

For every fixed m>=2, the unrestricted estimate, its connected simply connected case, equality kappa(#^p((K3)^m))=p for every positive p, equality for an unbounded set of p, and stable slope one are equivalent. These are complete proved reductions to an unresolved lower bound, not a proof of that bound.

The full spin-framed circle-surgery construction, signed full-block spectral normalization, same-dimensional alpha comparison, connected-sum amplification, quantitative defect propagation and stable-slope proof are preserved. The exact smooth-limit obstruction and reverse-surgery/product-coefficient barriers remain. The authored symbolic sequence b_N is an inference countermodel, not a manifold or counterexample to the conjecture.

The audit-required whole section 7.1 replacement is applied exactly. Bär–Dahl's h-plus bound uses a specially selected spectral-gap metric. Flat tori defeat a blanket sharper one-chirality inequality; other justified metric-selection arguments are not ruled out.

[Bär–Dahl](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0204200v3) receives credit for the imported spectral surgery and same-dimensional invariance; [Oberwolfach Report 36/2014](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2014/36) supplies the original question; [Futaki](https://doi.org/10.1007/BF01232424) supplies the known scalar-flat bound; [Gromov–Lawson](https://annals.math.princeton.edu/1980/111-3/p02) corroborates the spin-bordism mechanism. No novelty or global-current-openness certification is claimed.

## Edition and review limits

This AI-assisted, unrefereed edition contains exactly six files: complete authored mathematics, scoped audit/acceptance and public scholarly-source metadata. It is not external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification.

Whole computational-verification passages, programs, generated results/certificates, fixtures, dataset contents, third-party source bodies and private coordination material are excluded. No excluded computation is converted into a prose certificate. Source PDF hashes/sizes and recorded inspection/version/access limitations remain. Edition preparation performs no new source retrieval, PDF rehash, source inspection or literature search. The audit's failed fresh OWR DOI retrieval and reliance on its retained hashed source are explicit; Bär–Dahl arXiv v3 and Futaki MPI 92-57 are the inspected manuscript versions.

Exactly six files are added under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30002633/. QUEUE.md and all unrelated entries remain unchanged. The work stays partial, first substantive attempt 1/5; editorial preparation adds no proof turn or accounting reset.

Strict clean-patch replay and independent/native Git object hashing passed locally. Those checks establish byte and packaging integrity, not mathematical truth, remote publication or CI success. Draft publication only; no merge, release, DOI or outside outreach.

Base commit: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
